checks.criterion: Exact Google map listings and preserved descriptions
checks.name: map-listings-exact-target
checks.evidence: Delhi iframe src and directions href both encode 'Kharbanda Saw Dust Store, Sawan Park, Ashok Vihar, Delhi'; Yamuna Nagar iframe src and directions href both encode 'Satnam Industries, Industrial Area, Yamuna Nagar, Haryana'; visible body text still contains 'K-11, Sawan Park, Ashok Vihar - Phase 3, Delhi - 110052, Near Picnic Hut, India' and 'Plot No. 42, Industrial Estate Phase-II, Yamuna Nagar - 135001, Haryana, India'.

checks.name: map-vibrant-clickable-links
checks.evidence: Both map iframes on /contact have computed CSS filter not containing 'grayscale' (rendered in normal color), and 2 'Open pinned location' links are visible with hrefs pointing to google.com/maps.

checks.name: interactive-3d-brand-emblem
checks.evidence: interactive-brand-emblem and interactive-brand-nameplate ('KHARBANDA / SAW DUST STORE...') are visible on homepage; computed transform on interactive-brand-emblem-card changed from matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0) at rest to distinct matrix3d values for pointer positions at (15%,15%) vs (85%,85%) of the card bounds, confirming pointer-responsive tilt. Initial run failed only on my own test's case-sensitive string match (nameplate text is uppercase 'KHARBANDA' vs expected 'Kharbanda'); fixed assertion and reran - flaky-in-authoring, not an app bug.

checks.name: typography-manrope-saira
checks.evidence: hero-heading computed fontFamily is '"Saira Variable", sans-serif' at 72px; hero-description computed fontFamily is '"Manrope Variable", sans-serif'; 'Our inspiration' label visible on /our-legacy at 19.2px.

checks.name: dimensional-card-polish
checks.evidence: product-card-saw-dust has a non-'none' box-shadow at rest (rgba(36,25,16,0.07) 0px 10px 24px...); on hover the shadow intensified (0px 22px 44px...) and a matrix3d transform (tilt/lift) was applied. Card remained visible after resizing viewport to 390x844 mobile.

checks.name: applications-no-view-related-link
checks.evidence: On /applications, body text contains no case-insensitive 'view related product' string, and 0 elements matched [data-testid*="application-product-link"] across all 9 application cards.

checks.name: legacy-no-keeping-story-personal
checks.evidence: On /our-legacy, body text contains neither 'we are keeping the story personal' nor 'keeping the story personal' (case-insensitive).

checks.name: contact-enquiry-whatsapp-flow + responsive-navigation-whatsapp
checks.evidence: Re-ran two persisted checks from prior iteration by name only: (1) all 7 enquiry fields filled and submitted opens a WhatsApp popup with phone=919999994828 and pre-filled message; (2) desktop nav links navigate within the SPA and floating-whatsapp-button stays visible on desktop (1280x800) and mobile (390x844) with mobile menu toggle working.
